# 2 Clement — Chapter 18 (EMET Literal)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 18
**Agent:** EMET (Literal)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. So let us also be of those who give thanks — of those who have served God and not of the ungodly who are judged.
2. For I myself also, being altogether sinful and not yet having escaped temptation, but still being in the midst of the snares of the devil, endeavor to pursue righteousness, so that I may be strong enough at least to come near it, fearing the judgment to come.
